changeSet.author: Abdula Basnukaev
changeSet.comment: Курация Фаза 6: перенос C9-перевода primary-матна в overlay (стабильный hadith-keyed ключ)
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO hd_field_overrides (id, entity_table, entity_id, field_name, override_value, is_null_override, hidden, edited_by, edited_at, reason) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'hd_matns', m.hadith_id, 'primary_text_ru', m.text_ru, false, false, adm.id, now(), 'миграция Фаза 6: перенос C9-перевода в overlay' FROM hd_matns m CROSS JOIN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'ADMIN' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1) adm WHERE m.is_primary = true AND m.text_ru IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hd_field_overrides o WHERE o.entity_table = 'hd_matns' AND o.entity_id = m.hadith_id AND o.field_name = 'primary_text_ru');
INSERT INTO hd_field_overrides (id, entity_table, entity_id, field_name, override_value, is_null_override, hidden, edited_by, edited_at, reason) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'hd_matns', m.hadith_id, 'primary_text_en', m.text_en, false, false, adm.id, now(), 'миграция Фаза 6: перенос C9-перевода в overlay' FROM hd_matns m CROSS JOIN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE role = 'ADMIN' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1) adm WHERE m.is_primary = true AND m.text_en IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hd_field_overrides o WHERE o.entity_table = 'hd_matns' AND o.entity_id = m.hadith_id AND o.field_name = 'primary_text_en');

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM hd_field_overrides WHERE entity_table = 'hd_matns' AND field_name IN ('primary_text_ru', 'primary_text_en') AND reason = 'миграция Фаза 6: перенос C9-перевода в overlay';
